title: InstructionsProviderDescriptor
description: Descriptor for a Pack-shipped Instructions Provider plug-in. Invoked exactly once per Run by the Initializer, before Control starts. Returns domain-specific RunContext properties (instructionsPayload + Pack-typed user config). Never writes to the Blackboard. Same sandboxing/versioning model as KSs but distinct contract. Network policy is asymmetric with KSs: the Provider is the single allowed network egress point of the Run (e.g. `git clone`, package-registry fetch, license database query) so KSs can remain `network: deny` and operate on already-materialised inputs. To preserve replayability (I-13), when network = allow the Provider MUST materialise its full input snapshot (e.g. repo working copy, SBOM seed, license cache) into BundleStore before returning; the engine validates BundleStore is non-empty after Provider invocation and aborts the Run otherwise when determinismMode = strict.

instructionsPayloadSchemaRef.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the JSON Schema that the returned instructionsPayload conforms to. Pack-owned schema.

network.description: `allow` permits this Provider to perform network egress (the only network-allowed plug-in role in a Run). When `allow`, materialisesInputToBundleStore SHOULD be true so the Run remains replayable from BundleStore alone.

materialisesInputToBundleStore.description: When true, the Provider commits its full materialised input snapshot to BundleStore before returning, and the engine enforces I-13: BundleStore MUST be non-empty after Provider invocation; otherwise the Run is aborted in strict determinismMode.
